description: Records an order request for a website's owner (the principal). Nothing is charged. While crypto is open for the contact_email, rail usdc_base answers an order_token, and no operator key is needed: start_crypto_payment is next. Otherwise, with a crypto rail, an approved operator gets a crypto quote (exact amount, address, 20-minute send window) next to the card link, or a hold that waits for a person or for the principal; every other request is answered pending_review and a person at Aruon reviews it. Without rail, or with rail "card", it is a card order. A person at Aruon checks the first order from a new agent operator or a new buyer before anything goes live; the payment service can also hold an order before it is quoted. Once quoted, a payment on Base can take about 20 minutes to finalise after the send. A person reviews first-time and large orders. Paying publishes nothing by itself: a person at Aruon reviews the build, and the site owner approves a preview before anything goes live.

authorization_statement.description: the principal's authorisation of this agent, logged; required with a crypto rail

contact.description: how a person at Aruon reaches the operator; required with a crypto rail

operator_id.description: your operator id, given by Aruon with your key

operator_key.description: your operator key, given by Aruon

principal.description: the site owner's details for the payment service's intake (all optional here; what is still missing comes back in principal.missing)

rail.description: card (the default, as with no rail): the website's card path, where an approved operator gets the product's checkout link for the site owner; this service itself answers a card order pending_review and a person at Aruon reviews it. Or one of list_products' rails

sku.description: a sku from list_products with a crypto total

name: create_order
title: Ask for a product for a website, paid in crypto
